site.lede: We design and engineer things carefully, keep them simple, and publish how each one works.
site.contact: Have a project? Get in touch.

flacmn.summary: Manages your digital music library: analyses each album’s quality, fixes tags and cover art, and sends your music to the flacmn phone app in the format you choose.

search.title: Search your tags
search.caption: One box searches artist, album, song, genre and label across the whole library.

quality.title: Check the real quality
quality.caption: Each track's spectrum is measured. A FLAC made from an MP3 or AAC shows its cutoff and is flagged as a lossy source.

tags.title: Fix tags and covers
tags.caption: Tags are checked against MusicBrainz and missing covers come from the Cover Art Archive, only when you ask.

send.title: Send it to your phone
send.caption: Pair the phone with a code over Wi-Fi, then send albums as the original, FLAC, ALAC, AAC or MP3, with every size shown first.

play.title: Play it on the phone
play.caption: The phone app plays it with its quality shown, and swipes to an XY scope in the cover's colour.

phdmn.summary: PhD research in experimental fluid mechanics: turbulence from a random jet array, porous disk settling, and machine-learning control of the tank.

principles.intro: Three rules for everything specmn makes, for ourselves or for a client.
principles.engineered: Every part is chosen for a reason, and every claim is measured, not guessed.
principles.documented: Each product comes with its guide: how it works, how to build it, how to repair it.
principles.simple: Standard parts inside, few controls outside, and nothing that isn't needed.

upcoming.intro: Products being designed now. Each will be published with its guide.
upcoming.radiomn: A radio with one numbered dial: internet radio and FM.
upcoming.airmn: An air purifier built from standard filters and PC fans.
upcoming.lampmn: A desk lamp with one knob, powered over USB-C.
upcoming.cammn: A camera on a Raspberry Pi, set with two knobs.

studio.intro: specmn also takes on client work, done the same way and documented as carefully.
studio.product: Taking a product from idea to working prototype: mechanics, electronics and software.
studio.documentation: Clear write-ups of how a design works and why, with drawings and animations.
studio.measurement: Tools that measure how a product really performs, so decisions rest on numbers.
